data.name: Kadeem
data.gender_notes: Kadeem is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'K-D-M' which means 'to be old, ancient or everlasting'. The name Kadeem carries the meaning “Ancient, Everlasting” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kadeem usually hope their child will grow to embody ancient, everlasting and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the deep wisdom and knowledge that comes with age and experience.
data.etymology: Kadeem belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ancient, Everlasting.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kadeem total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: قديم
in_arabic.long_meaning: قديم ومعروف منذ العصور القديمة، يستخدم هذا الاسم لوصف الشخص الذي يحمل تجارب وخبرات قديمة، ولذلك فهو يعتبر اسمًا مهمًا في الثقافة الإسلامية حيث يرمز إلى الحكمة والتعلم من الماضي

in_urdu.name: قدیم
in_urdu.meaning: پرانا اور قدیم زمانے سے معروف
in_urdu.long_meaning: پرانا اور قدیم زمانے سے معروف، یہ نام ان لوگوں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو پرانے زمانے کی تجربات اور علم کو اپنے اندر سموئے ہوئے ہوتے ہیں، اس ليے يہ نام اسلامي ثقافت میں بہت اہم ہے
